info.title: Client_Insight_Per_VLAN
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

client_ip_address.description: IP address leased to the client.

complete_time.description: Time (in microseconds) since Epoch at which client completed DHCP handshake.

default_router.description: Comma separated list of 'default router' IP addresses sent to client by DHCP Server.

dhcp_failed_server.description: Comma separated list of 'DHCP server' IP addresses on which failures happened due to DHCP process not completed, for example DHCP NAK.

dhcp_pkt_validation_failed_server.description: Comma separated list of 'DHCP server' IP addresses on which failures happened due to packet validations.

dns_server.description: Comma separated list of 'DNS server' IP addresses sent to client by DHCP Server.

error_code.description: DHCP error code for when DHCP client is in failed state: 'dhcp_failure':               DHCP exchange started, but not completed. 'dhcp_pkt_validation_failed': DHCP pkt validation failed for client.

server_ip_address.description: The IP address of DHCP Server that offered lease to client.

start_time.description: Time (in microseconds) since Epoch at which client intiated DHCP handshake.

status.description: Client DHCP onboarding status 'successful':  Client successfully onboarded. 'in_progress': Client onboarding is in progress. 'failed':      Client onboarding failed.  NOTE: If the dhcp status key itself is not set (empty) by the time L3 timeout  occurs, the status will be treated as timed out, i.e. no DHCP traffic observed  for client. L3 timeout period is set to 2 minutes.

ip_onboarding_status.description: This state indicates if the DHCP exchange is complete or not. 'ipv4_onboarding' : IPv4 on-boarding status. 'ipv6_onboarding' : IPv6 on-boarding status. 'in_progress' : Client onboarding is in progress. 'successful'  : Client successfully onboarded. 'dhcp_failure': DHCP exchange failed for the client. 'dhcp_timeout': DHCP traffic was not seen after authentication stage.

client_ip_address.description: IP address leased to the client.

default_router.description: Comma separated list of 'default router' IP addresses sent to client by DHCP Server.

dhcp_failed_server.description: Comma separated list of 'DHCP server' IP addresses on which failures happened due to DHCP process not completed, for example DHCP NAK.

dhcp_pkt_validation_failed_server.description: Comma separated list of 'DHCP server' IP addresses on which failures happened due to packet validations.

dhcp_status.description: Client DHCP ongoing status 'successful':  Client successfully got ip address. 'in_progress': Client ongoing is in progress. 'failed':      Client ongoing failed.

dns_server.description: Comma separated list of 'DNS server' IP addresses sent to client by DHCP Server.

failure_reason.description: DHCP error code for when DHCP client is in failed state: 'dhcp_failure':               DHCP exchange started, but not completed. 'dhcp_pkt_validation_failed': DHCP pkt validation failed for client.

server_ip_address.description: The IP address of DHCP Server that offered lease to client.
